problemStatement.formal: ∫_M K dA = 2π · χ(M) for compact orientable Riemannian 2-manifolds
problemStatement.plain: The total Gaussian curvature of a closed surface equals 2π times the Euler characteristic.
whyMatters: Fundamental bridge between local geometry (curvature) and global topology (χ)
Determines genus from curvature sign: K>0→sphere, K=0→torus, K<0→genus≥2
Precursor to Atiyah-Singer index theorem and modern differential geometry

proven: Total curvature is a topological invariant (metric-independent)
Genus determination: positive curvature → sphere, zero → torus, negative → genus ≥ 2
Area bound for positively curved surfaces
Concrete examples: standard sphere, flat torus, hyperbolic genus 2
open: Full constructive proof once Mathlib adds Riemannian geometry
knownResults.goal: Formalize smooth Gauss-Bonnet and its consequences

knowledge.progressSummary: Formalized the smooth Gauss-Bonnet theorem with strategic axiomatization of the core theorem (Mathlib lacks Riemannian geometry). 20+ consequence theorems fully proved with 0 sorries. Covers genus determination, curvature-topology constraints, average curvature, area bounds, discrete-smooth connection, and Chern-Gauss-Bonnet generalization.
insights: Mathlib v4.26.0 lacks Riemannian metrics, Gaussian curvature, manifold integration
Strategic axiomatization captures correct mathematical content with minimal axioms
CompactRiemannianSurface structure: one axiom (gauss_bonnet) gives 20+ theorems
simp can close field_simp goals for concrete examples (no extra field_simp needed)

approaches.description: Axiomatize CompactRiemannianSurface with gauss_bonnet axiom, then prove all consequences: genus determination, curvature-topology constraints, average curvature, concrete examples.
